caption: Basilica Palladiana, Vicenza
composition: Palladian loggia and green copper roof on Piazza dei Signori · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Seen from across the empty piazza, the basilica's two-tiered white loggia runs the full length of the frame, its green copper roof and small domed bell tower rising behind. A red-brick palazzo anchors the left edge and a row of ochre houses the right, under a flat overcast sky. At 07:29 the light is soft and shadowless, and the wet-looking stones of the square give the pale building its full presence.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Basilica Palladiana in Vicenza under overcast morning light
